author: golem
body:
I reviewed frozen upload-diagnostic-proposal-v2.md SHA3c655f900270f6fb7c681dad4d924c9d96825dcf19a7ef8c8d1f49bf4a8567ed and its freeze. Accepted: ONE fresh Pi JIT exacthistory, complete ONLY workspaceupload/consolidation+validbarrier or30sno-enqueue/180soverall diagnosticbound; no laterRUN/metadata-out/recovery. Original435B suffix must match; totalplannedwire3488356B. Publicatomic at most3records, CTS/poll return state, normalbackendjoin10s/IOjoin2s, missingcleanup/failedjoin/nonreproduced distinct. No consumer/timing pass inferred.

Release separate task-local diagnostic SOURCE/HOST preparation now; no emulator instantiation yet. Keep original consumer/transport/module/firmware/backend/control bytes untouched. Freeze code/input/actualcommand receipt and return readiness before a separate root Pi run permit. Meaningful host checks should prove partial-send deadline suppresses every later firmwarebyte/recovery, boundedreturn/blocked-predicate disposition and successful exactplanstream, not mirror implementation exhaustively.

One implementation review point: finalraw accounting/filewrites must occur after the IOwriter is quiescent (or be explicitly incomplete if it cannotjoin). Existing Target.close writes observed/raw files; do not race a still-running IOworker and label results exact. It is fine to call the ordinary public backendshutdown/join path directly in your separateharness and flush only after bothjoins, without modifying genericTarget or privateobjects. Report cleanup status as source actually establishes it. No new target/profile/Oryx launch/retry or source repair under this preparation release.
